notes: 2026-05-07: University of Southern Denmark (SDU) gained research access to Quantinuum Helios via DeiC (Danish e-Infrastructure Consortium). SDU is testing fault-tolerant algorithms and error-correction codes at 48 logical qubit scale. This is a deployment/access milestone confirming Helios is available commercially beyond US borders as a research cloud service. Hardware specs unchanged from Feb 2026 iceberg-code paper (arXiv 2602.22211): 98 physical / 94 logical (error-detection mode) / 48 logical (error-correction mode). Logical gate error rate ~1e-4. This is an availability update, not a performance update — no new frontier numbers. RELEVANCE TO OUR WORK: SDU access confirms Helios is obtainable for independent research partnerships. Our QCUP PHY204 2-point force-existence proposal would run on exactly this hardware at this logical qubit count.
